baseline: Streaming decoder after pipeline buffer reuse, direct planar GPU output and synchronization reuse optimizations
mode: streaming / Metal / planar / four decoder workers / IQ8
changes: ARM NEON four-sample I/Q differential products and double-precision energy in 64-sample batches
ARM NEON double-precision FMA synchronization fits across two timing phases per vector
Apple Accelerate vDSP_svesq for contiguous waterfall display power

precision.frontend: ARM vector differential products match scalar fused multiply-add order; double-precision energy preserved; 10000 randomized arithmetic cases plus silence and scalar tails passed
precision.synchronization: Same nine timing phases, same sample order per phase, same thresholds and single payload decode
precision.waterfall: Float vector sum with changed summation order only for display power; tested within 0.0001 dB of scalar double result; packet RSSI/noise unchanged

benchmark.limitations: Live receiver running concurrently; short replay capacity and decoder CPU measurements, not whole-system CPU or battery use. GPU code unchanged; timing variation is not a GPU optimization.

binary_verification: NEON ld2.4s, fmla.4s and fmla.2d in native executable
